guidance.bestFor: The bare minimum of 3 plain text rows in a single group, with the middle row disabled

whenNotToUse.when: A long list that needs headed sections and a key hint on every row

name: c-context-menu-2
title: Context menu with icons for common actions.
label: Icons
description: Context menu with icons for common actions.

guidance.bestFor: Clipboard commands, Copy, Cut and Paste, each with a leading icon, and a destructive Delete below a divider

whenNotToUse.when: Record actions such as edit, share and archive rather than clipboard commands

guidance.bestFor: Navigation and save commands with a trailing key hint on each row and Forward disabled
agentNotes: `ContextMenuShortcut` is a plain span that only prints the key hint; bind the Save and Reload keys in your own keydown handler

whenNotToUse.when: Key hints sorted under File and Edit headings

guidance.bestFor: A More Tools flyout of 3 divided groups, Delete last, below 2 clipboard rows with key hints

whenNotToUse.when: A flat list with every action, Delete included, at the top level

guidance.bestFor: A list of 4 groups, File and Edit headed by labels, with a key hint on every row down to a destructive Delete

whenNotToUse.when: A short list of 3 rows with no headings or key hints

guidance.bestFor: A list of 3 browser view toggles that show a check when on, 2 of them on at load
agentNotes: Base items keep their own state from `defaultChecked`, so nothing reads them; pass `checked` and `onCheckedChange` as the radix twin does

whenNotToUse.when: A setting where picking one option clears the others

guidance.bestFor: A person picker and a Light, Dark or System theme switch, each a headed radio set held in state
agentNotes: `user` and `theme` keep the picks in local state through `onValueChange`; persist them or lift them into your app from there
The 2 people are hardcoded `ContextMenuRadioItem` rows keyed by `value`; map them from your own user list

whenNotToUse.when: Options that each switch on or off without affecting the rest

guidance.bestFor: Edit and Share over a divider, then Archive and a destructive Delete, every row led by an icon
agentNotes: The destructive `variant` only colors Delete; it runs nothing and asks for no confirmation, so open an alert dialog from it

whenNotToUse.when: Copy, cut and paste commands for selected text or files

name: c-context-menu-9
title: Context menu with different alignment sides.
label: Alignment Sides
description: Context menu with different alignment sides.

guidance.bestFor: A row of 6 triggers that each open on a different side, the logical inline start and end included
agentNotes: `side` places `ContextMenuContent` on the base twin only; Radix pins it right of the pointer, so the radix twin's 4 triggers open alike

name: c-context-menu-10
title: Context menu used inside a dialog component.
label: Inside Dialog
description: Context menu used inside a dialog component.

guidance.bestFor: A right click area inside a modal window, with icon rows, a More Options flyout and a destructive Delete
